content.sensitivity: For both systems, ORCA 6.1.1 reproduced the PySCF TDA S1 within 0.000205 eV. Replacing TDA with full linear-response TDDFT at CAM-B3LYP/def2-SVP lowered S1 by 0.248457 eV (An-sigma-Ph) and 0.242514 eV (An-sigma-DA). This S1-only sensitivity is directionally favorable to 2T1>S1 and leaves the >0.5 eV S1-T1 condition satisfied if the primary T1 is held fixed; full-TDDFT triplet sensitivity was not available through the validated ORCA action.
content.coverage: Both manifest systems completed 3D generation, tight singlet S0 optimization, Hessian/stationary-point analysis, five-root singlet and triplet calculations, state ordering checks, both requested derived gaps, both inequality tests, and S1 method/software sensitivity calculations.
content.conclusion: Within the isolated-molecule vertical TDA/CAM-B3LYP/def2-SVP convention at GFN2-xTB S0 minima, both An-sigma-Ph and An-sigma-DA satisfy 2T1>S1 and S1-T1>0.5 eV. The donor/acceptor terminal substitution changes the values only slightly: it lowers S1 by about 0.028 eV and T1 by about 0.008 eV relative to An-sigma-Ph, while both energetic criteria remain clearly met.
content.limitations: These are isolated-molecule vertical excitations at one optimized conformer, without solvent, aggregation, vibronic, thermal, excited-state relaxation, or device effects. Geometry and stationary-point evidence are at GFN2-xTB rather than DFT. The TDA approximation changes S1 by about 0.24-0.25 eV relative to full TDDFT; an equivalent full-TDDFT triplet check was unavailable in the validated ORCA action. The name-to-graph construction was formula/charge/multiplicity checked, but no external deposited structure was available.

reproducibility.settings: Isolated singlet anions, charge -1 and multiplicity 1. RDKit ETKDGv3/UFF screening used deterministic seeds 20260921 (A) and 20260922 (B), 24 requested embeddings, 0.35 A RMS pruning, and the lowest converged UFF candidate. ORCA used PBE0/def2-SVPD, D3BJ, SMD(DMSO), Tight optimization, maximum 250 steps, and explicit harmonic Hessians. HOMO is the highest orbital with occupation >1e-8 from a same-method ORCA orbital calculation on the optimized geometry. Difference = B - A.
reproducibility.limitations: Only one unique conformer survived ETKDG RMS pruning for each rigid scaffold. Continuum-solvent Kohn-Sham eigenvalues depend on functional, basis, cavity/model, and conformer; no counterion or explicit DMSO was included. The small external-mode residuals were excluded from the 3N-6 vibrational subspace.

method.description: Unconstrained gas-phase r2SCAN-3c tight geometry optimization and analytic Hessian for each neutral singlet, followed by a wB97X-3c single-point electronic energy. Gibbs energies use G = E[wB97X-3c] + the r2SCAN-3c thermal correction at 298.15 K and 1 atm. GoodVibes applies Grimme quasi-RRHO entropy and Head-Gordon quasi-harmonic enthalpy treatments, both with 100 cm^-1 cutoffs; frequency and ZPE scale factors are 1.0 and rotational symmetry corrections are omitted because every endpoint is C1.

comparison.trend_statement: The dipole grows strongly and monotonically, 1.0891 < 3.5881 < 6.2436 D. The ESP range rises from 29.8569 to 64.7041 to 65.7300 kcal mol^-1 e^-1: the first CN creates most of the additional high/low contrast, while the second largely duplicates the nitrile-negative region and balances positive and negative extreme magnitudes. Signed extrema asymmetry changes +0.5691 -> -0.1015 -> -0.00985.

hypothesis_and_test.hypothesis: Each cyano group introduces a strong bond-dipole contribution and a localized negative ESP lobe at terminal N. In the 3,4-dicyano member, symmetry cancels opposing transverse components but reinforces the common molecular-axis component; therefore the total dipole can continue growing even if the global ESP range saturates.
hypothesis_and_test.evidence: The dipoles increase by +2.499 and +2.656 D on successive CN addition. The minimum moves from Br (-6.43) to nitrile N (-35.64 kcal mol^-1 e^-1) after the first CN. The two N regions in M-Th-2CN have nearly equal means (-19.77 and -19.71) and minima (-33.19 and -33.05), while its extrema-asymmetry index returns close to zero. This supports localized acceptor lobes plus vector reinforcement, rather than a claim that every additional CN must double the single most-negative potential.

content.conclusion: Within isolated neutral-singlet PBE0 calculations, cyano substitution increases the molecular dipole markedly and monotonically. One CN changes the ESP qualitatively by placing the negative extremum on nitrile N and more than doubling Vmax-Vmin; a second CN changes the spatial balance and dipole much more than it changes the already-large ESP range.
content.limitations: Single-functional results at one optimized minimum were used. The 0.20 Angstrom marching-edge surface discretization limits extrema precision, and no grid-spacing or functional sensitivity series was performed. The conclusions apply only to the specified isolated neutral ground-state monomers.

method.frequency_method: ORCA 6.1.1 r2SCAN-3c analytic Hessian with mass-weighted nonlinear-mode analysis
method.justification: r2SCAN-3c provides a dispersion-aware, cost-effective geometry model for broad conformer refinement. The range-separated hybrid wB97X-D4 with a polarized triple-zeta def2-TZVPP basis was selected for frontier orbital energies and the fixed-geometry electronic dipole because it reduces long-range self-interaction error while retaining an explicit modern dispersion model; def2-TZVP provides a controlled basis-size sensitivity check.

conformer_search.deduplication: CREST 3.0.2/GFN2-xTB generated 98 gas-phase conformers within 6 kcal/mol. All retained the fixed 53-atom molecular graph/element sequence. Heavy atoms were aligned and clustered at 0.75 A RMSD; the lowest-GFN2-xTB-energy member of each cluster defined 46 unique basins.

conformer_search.coverage_rationale: All 30 distinct basins at or below 3.80 kcal/mol at GFN2-xTB were advanced to the same r2SCAN-3c Tight optimization, covering conformers with appreciable room-temperature relevance and nearby basins capable of changing dipole or frontier levels. The 16 higher screened basins were retained in the record but not refined.
conformer_search.stopping_evidence: All 30 advanced optimizations converged. Their final r2SCAN-3c span is 3.651383 kcal/mol; AZ9-C45 is lowest at -1719.653801181725 Ha. AZ9-C44 converged to an energetically indistinguishable minimum (0.0000049 kcal/mol above C45).

selected_structure.selection_basis: AZ9-C45 was the lowest electronic-energy member among all 30 consistently optimized r2SCAN-3c candidates and was subsequently verified as a true minimum by its Hessian.

stationarity.evidence: ORCA r2SCAN-3c Hessian job job_8326983b38d940c386e654b27b227256 and deterministic nonlinear mass-weighted analysis job job_f3e946ad553f411688013111eaeeb048 yielded 153 vibrational modes, zero imaginary vibrations, and a lowest vibrational frequency of 13.5112 cm^-1. The six projected translation/rotation modes lie between -5.3413 and +6.7579 cm^-1, consistent with numerical residue.

sensitivity.test: Repeat wB97X-D4 fixed-geometry orbital and dipole calculations with def2-TZVP instead of def2-TZVPP; deltas are TZVP minus TZVPP.
sensitivity.interpretation: Basis contraction changes HOMO, LUMO, and gap by at most 0.0023 eV and the dipole by 0.0147 D (about 1.1%), supporting numerical stability with respect to this basis-size check.

content.conclusion: At the frequency-validated gas-phase minimum, AZ9 has a large 8.6028 eV Kohn-Sham frontier gap, high orbital-derived hardness (4.3014 eV), and low softness (0.11624 eV^-1), indicating low frontier-orbital polarizability/reactivity within the specified conceptual-DFT model. Its 1.3594 D electronic dipole is modest. The positive LUMO energy makes the orbital-derived EA negative (-0.2877 eV), so this approximation does not predict a bound added electron. The basis sensitivity is very small, although the IP and EA are Koopmans-style orbital descriptors rather than delta-SCF ionization/attachment energies, and conclusions apply to the isolated neutral singlet minimum.
limitations: IP and EA are defined from neutral Kohn-Sham frontier orbital energies exactly as requested, not from charged-state total-energy differences.
Gas-phase results exclude solvent, counterions, protonation alternatives, temperature averaging, and experimental calibration.
Only the selected lowest electronic-energy structure was frequency validated; other advanced candidates have converged optimization evidence but no Hessians.
